title: Create one natural photographic portrait
prompt:
Create one natural photographic portrait of a new fictional 22-year-old East Asian adult woman resting on her stomach across a grey textured bedspread, cuddling a large pale-pink plush bear against her cheek. Use a vertical 2:3 composition with realistic close camera perspective at mattress level, her face and near shoulder prominent on the right and her softly bent lower body receding diagonally toward the left. Recompose the room edges to keep her complete head, the visible arm support and the plush bear comfortably inside the portrait, with some quiet wall space above. Her near forearm stretches down toward the lower edge and supports her gently raised upper body; the rest of her body rests naturally on the mattress. Keep a slender adult frame, moderately narrow relaxed shoulders and a natural adult head-to-shoulder ratio, without exaggerated narrowing or enlarged shoulders.

Her eyes are gently closed and her lips form a small warm, contented closed-mouth smile as her cheek nestles into the plush fur. Give her an individual softly oval adult face with a delicate tapered jaw, smooth rounded cheek planes, fine softly arched eyebrows, a small straight nose with a round tip, and luminous pink lips with a subtle cupid's bow. Her loose dark shoulder-length bob has an off-center part, a slightly lifted crown, uneven soft ends and a few flyaway strands along the cheek and shoulder. Keep adult facial proportions, gentle natural blush and delicate skin microtexture with light retouching. Do not make a doll-like face.

She wears a lightweight ivory camisole mini dress with tiny faded pink floral sprigs and a subtle fine grid woven into the fabric. Preserve the thin pale straps, soft edged low neckline, fitted upper bodice and small gathered folds where the dress follows her resting torso and hips. Keep the original relaxed garment structure and naturally visible neckline without deepening it, with opaque fabric covering intimate areas. A small pink-red decorative floral decal with a few thin circular line motifs sits on the outer upper arm. This is a delicate surface decoration, not an injury. The pale-pink teddy bear fills the lower right foreground; its soft fluffy fur, round head and small dark eye press gently against her cheek. Keep the interaction affectionate and everyday, with no sexual action or suggestive emphasis.

The setting is a simple lived-in room: a warm off-white wall, a dark reddish-brown paneled wooden door with a silver lever at the left, a pair of small white wall switches, and part of a slim light-colored framed blue-grey picture of small boats at the upper right. A grey plush bedspread covers the foreground and supports her elbow and body with small believable compression folds. Soft broad daylight fills the room, gently modeling the face, shoulder and fabric without dramatic spotlights or harsh sun stripes. Use warm-neutral skin tones, restrained blush pink accents and gentle contrast, with believable shadow under her forearm and against the toy. Keep the woman dominant while allowing enough room context for a relaxed candid snapshot. Natural anatomy, realistic cloth and plush texture, fine photographic detail, no readable lettering, no added signage, no collage, no border, no logo and no watermark. Output one complete native 2:3 vertical image.
